ipa.note: Unsigned sideload IPA built by the ios-ipa job. Hard budget: a PR fails when it grows more than maxGrowthPercent over the baseline. Baseline: main after #7 (bundled Kokoro model), ios-ipa run 37542120127, build 133. Change it only on purpose: node tools/budgets.ts set-ipa <bytes>, with the reason in the PR.
